column4: (async () => { await viz.ready(); const cv = document.getElementById('cv'), cw = cv.clientWidth, ch = cv.clientHeight, id = (i) => document.getElementById(i), J = JSON.stringify, bad = [], rt = (tag, o, want) => { const s0 = J(viz.sel); id('scp').click(); const tx = viz.copied(); viz.set('sel', null); const r = viz.jump(tx); if (J(viz.sel) !== s0 || r.kind !== want) bad.push(o + ' ' + tag + ' ' + tx); }; viz.set('view', 'top'); viz.set('sel', null); for (const o of ['0,0', '37,-52']) { viz.set('origin', o); const pt = [cw / 2, ch / 2], pt2 = [cw / 2 + 90, ch / 2 + 50]; viz.set('sel', null); viz.click(...pt, 0); rt('左键整条', o, 'sel'); viz.set('sel', null); viz.click(...pt, 0); const h0 = J(viz.state().hit), sb = J(viz.sel); id('ppt').click(); const tp = viz.copied(); viz.set('sel', null); viz.jump(tp); if (J(viz.sel) !== sb || J(viz.state().hit) !== h0) bad.push(o + ' ⎘点 ' + tp); viz.set('sel', null); viz.click(...pt, 2); viz.click(...pt, 2); rt('右键单格', o, 'sel'); viz.set('sel', null); viz.click(...pt, 2); viz.click(...pt2, 2); rt('矩形', o, 'sel'); const q = viz.jump('@5,6^70'); if (q.kind !== 'sel') bad.push(o + ' 单点 ' + q.kind); } viz.set('sel', null); viz.set('origin', '0,0'); viz.errors(); return { ok: !bad.length, msg: bad.join(' | ') || '左键整条 / 右键两下单格 / 矩形 × 原点 0,0 与 37,-52：复制 → 清空 → 粘贴 往返一致（含 ⎘ 点 → hit 相等）' }; })()

column4: (async () => { await viz.ready(); const os = [[0, 0], [6000, -4000], [-120, 300], [40000, 25000]], bad = [], px = () => { const c = document.getElementById('mini'), d = c.getContext('2d').getImageData(0, 0, c.width, c.height).data; let n = 0; for (let i = 0; i < d.length; i += 4) if (d[i] + d[i + 1] + d[i + 2] > 60) n++; return n / (c.width * c.height); }; for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++) os.forEach((o, i) => viz.previewOrigin({ n: 'o' + i, x: o[0], z: o[1] })); for (const o of os) { viz.previewOrigin({ n: 't', x: o[0], z: o[1] }); const q = await viz.previewReady(); const f = px(); if (!q.ok || f < 0.3) bad.push(o + ' ok=' + q.ok + ' 非黑 ' + f.toFixed(2)); } viz.endPreview(); viz.errors(); return { ok: !bad.length, msg: bad.join(' | ') || '4 个原点 × 3 轮快速悬停后逐个读回，小图非黑像素 ≥ 30%' }; })()
